row.evidence: PathFactory's SSO FAQ answers "Does PathFactory support auto-user provisioning?" with "No. There is no automatic synchronization of users between PathFactory and your identity provider."
row.notes: New row. Quote-only: PathFactory publishes no pricing page (pricing is through a demo request), so team and SSO plans are unknown. SAML 2.0 SSO is enabled on request through the CSM or support, with guides for Okta, OneLogin and G Suite plus generic SAML; no plan is named. The SSO FAQ states there is no automatic user provisioning and no SAML single logout; users are added one at a time or by CSV upload. The REST API v3 has a read-only users_info endpoint (user list with active/suspended/deleted flags) but no write operations. Status none is stated by the vendor.

scim.notes: The SSO FAQ says there is no automatic user synchronization between PathFactory and the IdP.

auth.notes: API v3 introduces OAuth 2.0 authentication and role-based API keys.

rate_limits.text: 180 calls per minute and 10,000 calls per hour per key.

user_api.notes: The help-centre API reference lists /public/v3/users_info ('Details information of the users within your PathFactory application') with fields active, created_at, deleted, email, id, name, organization_id, suspended, updated_at, username, uuid. No HTTP method is printed, so it is not listed under endpoints; no create/update/delete user endpoints are documented.

okta.notes: PathFactory's Okta guide has admins create a custom SAML application; okta.com/integrations/pathfactory/ returns 404.

entra.notes: No Entra guide; generic SAML 2.0 option exists. learn.microsoft.com pathfactory-tutorial returns 404.

google.notes: Vendor guide 'Configure SSO for G Suite' (SAML).

fallbacks.notes: CSV upload covers Email, Username, Name, User Role, Active and SSO fields and can bulk-edit existing users.
